content: मोक्षः [मोक्ष्-घञ्] .²1 Liberation, release, escape, freedom; साऽधुना तव बन्धे मोक्षे च प्रभवति <ls>K.</ls>; <ls>Me. 63</ls>; लब्धमोक्षाः शुकादयः <ls>R. 17. 20</ls>; धुर्याणां च धुरो मोक्षम् <ls n="R.">17. 19</ls>. .²2 Rescue, deliverance, delivery; ते यतध्वं परं शक्त्या सर्वे मोक्षाय पार्थिवाः <ls>Mb. 5. 173. 15</ls>. .²3 Final emancipation, deliverance of the soul from recurring births or transmigration, the last of the four ends of human existence; see अर्थ; धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां यस्यैकोऽपि न विद्यते . अजागलस्तनस्येव तस्य जन्म निरर्थकम् ..; <ls>Bg. 5. 28</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">18. 30</ls>; <ls>Ms. 6. 35</ls>; <ls>R. 10. 84</ls>. .²4 Death. .²5 Falling down, dropping down, falling off; वनस्थलीर्मर्मरपत्रमोक्षाः <ls>Ku. 3. 31</ls>. .²6 Loosening, untying, unbinding; वेणिमोक्षोत्सुकानि <ls>Me. 101</ls>; मदकलयुवतीनां नीविमोक्षस्तु मोक्षः .²7 Shedding, causing to fall down or flow; बाष्पमोक्ष, अश्रुमोक्ष. .²8 Shooting, casting, discharging; बाणमोक्षः <ls>Ś. 3. 5</ls>. .²9 Scattering, strewing. .²10 Acquittance or discharge of an obligation (debt <ab>&c.</ab>). .²11 (In <ab>astr.</ab>) The liberation of an eclipsed planet, the end of an eclipse. .²12 <ab>N.</ab> of a tree (पाटलि). .²13 Utterance (of a curse). .²14 Settling (a question).
